bhutakancukitadavimuktobhuyahpatisamahpa.deva: भूतकञ्चुकी तदा विमुक्तो भूयः पतिसमः परः
bhutakancukitadavimuktobhuyahpatisamahpa.iast: Bhūtakañcukī tadā vimukto bhūyaḥ patisamaḥ paraḥ.
bhutakancukitadavimuktobhuyahpatisamahpa.literal: Then, though still clothed in the elements, one is liberated, supremely complete, and like the Lord.
